# Physio exercises

## Notes

New shoes after 700 kilometres, the old ones are flat. Strength training twice a week keeps the injuries away. Long run on Sunday, easy pace, around 3 kilometres.

## Context

Easy runs should feel easy, I keep running them too fast. Race goal is to finish under two hours, without walking. Resting heart rate is down to 3000 after three months.

## Status

Rest day means really resting, a walk is fine. Intervals on Monday: six times 800 metres with two minutes rest. Drink before the long run, take a gel after one hour.

## Open questions

Iris joins the Thursday run, slower pace that day. Knee felt sore after the hill session, skip hills this week. Protein with every meal, more vegetables at dinner.

## Next steps

- Weekly distance goes up by at most ten percent.
